newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end weaker on strong yen.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end weaker on strong yen.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower across the board on Wednesday, depressed by weaker overseas markets and the yen's rise against the dollar, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.2 yen to 2.4 yen per kg lower, with benchmark September finishing down 1.9 yen at 145.8 yen.
Prices opened lower as long liquidation emerged from the outset, although activity ebbed later in the day.

"Market sentiment remained bearish with no bullish factors in sight," one trader said. Open interest in rubber futures has fallen steadily in recent months. On April 1 it stood at 135,549 lots, down 2,724 lots from the previous session.
